Title: Verify that the user is able to login successfully with valid credentials
Pre-condition: User is on the login page
Test Steps:
1. Launch browser and navigate to Sauce Demo URL
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter valid password
4. Click on Login button
Expected Result (ER): User is redirected to Products page and inventory items are displayed

Title: Verify that login is denied for locked out user
Pre-condition: User is on the login page
Test Steps:
1. Enter Username: locked_out_user
2. Enter Password: secret_sauce
3. Click Login button
Expected Result (ER): Error message displayed: "Sorry, this user has been locked out."

Title: Verify that login fails with invalid username
Pre-condition: User is on the login page
Test Steps:
1. Enter invalid username
2. Enter valid password
3. Click Login
Expected Result (ER): Error message: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"
